facts.fact: 倒计时：十二月一号明天就到——距圣诞愿望兑现不足一个月，Bryony 自认任务近乎不可能。
facts.anchor: So, Blondie. December the first tomorrow.

facts.fact: 荒唐药方：她打定主意周六请 David 进门「喝咖啡」然后吻他——以为吻别人能治好对 Jack 的执念。
facts.anchor: She was going to invite him in for coffee and she was going to kiss him.

facts.fact: 教学场：Jack 凭预感让备血十单位，一步步教 Bryony 认出主动脉破裂的 X 光征象，还夸她 full marks。
情敌觉醒：David 直言怀疑 Jack 蓄意破坏他们每次约会——Bryony 还在替他辩解。
facts.anchor: ‘Aren’t you beginning to wonder why it is that Jack Rothwell would want to sabotage every date we have?’

facts.fact: 摊牌：Jack 当众截人——你的约会结束了，现在我送她回家；还把 Nina 塞给 David 当「补偿」。
facts.anchor: ‘You’ve had your date,’ he drawled softly, ‘and now I’m taking her home.’

facts.fact: 双标现场：她怒斥他虚伪——嫌她的黑裙，却陪着深 V 的 Nina 谈笑风生，外套只给她一人披过。
facts.anchor: I didn’t notice you covering her up with a coat.

facts.fact: 引爆句：她数落自己一个月连个吻都没混到——Jack 当场把她拉过去吻。
facts.anchor: A whole month has gone past since Lizzie sent her letter to Santa and so far I haven’t even managed to get a man to kiss me.

facts.fact: 车吻：惩罚般的强吻让她的手指先叛变——勾进他衬衫里；她只觉得像魔法。
facts.anchor: brought his mouth down on hers with punishing force.

facts.fact: 落荒：她高傲道谢「谢谢陪练」，强吻他脸颊下车走人——绝不回头。
